summary: The client reported frequent wifi drops and requested assistance with the issue. After investigating interference on their network channel, the agent remotely changed the channel setting to improve stability. While the change usually helps, there’s no guarantee of complete resolution. The customer stated they might call back if it continues occurring.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the standard greeting and acknowledged the customer’s issue promptly.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a calm tone and avoided interrupting or escalating the situation.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent offered a solution (channel change) and explained what would happen next.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to the customer's concerns without interruption.

intense.speaker: Client
intense.text: My wifi keeps dropping every few minutes, it's driving me crazy.

suggestions: Interference on the channel is causing issues.
Check router settings for other channels.
Run a speed test to verify internet stability.
Schedule a technician visit if it continues.

compliance.name: Discourtesy
compliance.rule: Never be discourteous: no profanity, bashing, impatience, or sarcasm toward the customer

compliance.name: Escalation
compliance.rule: Escalate to a supervisor when the customer asks

compliance.name: Call Avoidance
compliance.rule: Do not avoid the call: never refuse to help or push the customer away without a valid reason

response_times.client_text: My wifi keeps dropping every few minutes, it's driving me crazy.
response_times.agent_text: Have you tried restarting the router?

response_times.client_text: I just told you I did that multiple times.
response_times.agent_text: Fine, let me actually look at the line then.
There's some interference on your channel.
Other networks nearby are on the same channel as yours.
I'll change your wifi channel remotely, that should reduce the drops.

response_times.client_text: Should? Will it or won't it?
response_times.agent_text: It usually helps, but I can't guarantee it completely.

response_times.client_text: So I might be calling back again.
response_times.agent_text: If it keeps happening, we can send a technician.

response_times.client_text: You could have offered that sooner.
response_times.agent_text: The channel change is applied. Give it a day.
